[Notices of Layoffs and Closures — WARNs](https://www.michigan.gov/leo/bureaus-agencies/wd/data-public-notices/warn-notices "Notices of Layoffs and Closures — WARNs") ## Disclaimer notice * All Worker Adjustment and Retraining Notifications (WARNs) are posted as a public courtesy and reflect the information provided by employers. The number of affected jobs is published only when it is included in the employer’s WARN submission. In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA), original WARNs received by the Michigan Department of Labor and Economic Opportunity, Workforce Development (LEO‑WD) have been replaced with accessible versions beginning with the year 2025. The WARNs posted on this page use an ADA‑compliant template and are not in their original format. * ## How to request accessibility accommodations We are committed to providing equal access and opportunity to all users, including those who require additional accessibility accommodations. If you are having difficulty accessing any part of our website or need assistance, please email us at [LEO-WARN@michigan.gov](mailto:LEO-WARN@michigan.gov "Email the Rapid Response team."). Please include your name, contact information, and a brief description of the issue you are experiencing. We will assist you and provide any necessary accommodations. * ## How to request an unlisted WARN notice To request a WARN not available on this website, a Freedom of Information Act (FOIA) request must be submitted. Once the LEO-WD Equal Opportunity contact receives the FOIA request, the requested data will be provided.
